# Kumpuni

> Kumpuni is a Windows printer diagnostics and repair app.

This interactive mockup demonstrates printer selection, simulated diagnosis, repair and verification, and a technician console with queue, driver and port inventory. It uses demo data.

## Pages

- [Kumpuni UI Mockup](https://kumpuni-ui-mockup.trypragma.site/): Try the demo and download its redacted reports.
